data.name: Ghasasini
data.gender_notes: Ghasasini is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ghasas', meaning to be generous or beneficent. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person who is kind, just, and charitable, spreading blessings and positivity around them. The name Ghasasini carries the meaning “Generous, Beneficent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ghasasini usually hope their child will grow to embody generous, beneficent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ghasasini belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous, Beneficent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghasasini total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: غساسيني
in_arabic.meaning: غساس (ghasas) = avenger, vindicator, seeker of justice, one who avenges
in_arabic.long_meaning: The one who is an avenger or vindicator, one who seeks justice and avenges wrongs. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge.

in_urdu.name: غساسینی
in_urdu.meaning: غساس (ghasas) = استراحت می کنندہ (istrakh makannadah) = One who does not rest (from seeking justice)
in_urdu.long_meaning: The one who is relentless in seeking justice and never rests until wrongs are righted. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Urdu phrase 'istrakh makannadah' which means one who does not rest.

in_hindi.name: घससीनी
in_hindi.meaning: घसस (ghasas) = सत्यार्थी (satyaarthi) = Truth seeker, one who pursues justice
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a truth seeker and one who pursues justice. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Hindi phrase 'satyaarthi' which means truth seeker.

in_pashto.name: غساسني
in_pashto.long_meaning: The one who is an enemy or adversary. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'ghasasa' which means to take revenge or to avenge, and the Pashto word 'dushman' which means enemy or adversary.

In some parts of the Islamic world, individuals bearing this name may be expected to embody these qualities in their daily lives and interactions with others.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Ghasasini carries deeper meaning and importance. In Islamic teachings, being kind and generous is seen as an act of worship and an expression of faith. By focusing on the well-being of others, an individual embraces the principles of compassion and mercy, as exemplified by the Prophet Muhammad and other spiritual leaders of the faith. Moreover, the act of giving and sharing resources – whether it's time, resources, or knowledge – is often seen as a means of growing closer to God and fostering positive spiritual growth in oneself. Thus, the name Ghasasini evokes a sense of spiritual fulfillment and closeness to the divine through its association with the virtue of generosity.
